name: STRATUS
recent: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad 近期出现多项大股东（EPF）持股变动公告，同时主席兼董事 Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 在8月至10月间多次减持公司股份。公司亦被媒体列为半导体自动化领域的关注标的。
notable: 主席兼董事 Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 在2026年8月至10月间多次减持公司股份。
EPF 在2026年10月出现持股权益变动，包括成为大股东及不再是大股东的通知。
risks: 主席兼董事 Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor 在2026年8月至10月间多次减持股份。
EPF 在2026年10月出现不再是大股东（Ceasing）的公告。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止期间，公司录得营收 MYR 34,844,000，净利 MYR 9,548,000，净利率 27.4%。

recent_en: Stratus Global Holdings Berhad recently saw several substantial shareholder (EPF) interest change announcements, while Chairman & Director Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of shares multiple times between August and October. The company was also featured in media as a stock pick in semiconductor automation.
notable_en: Chairman & Director Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of company shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
EPF had changes in shareholding interest in October 2026, including notices of becoming and ceasing to be a substantial shareholder.
risks_en: Chairman & Director Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of shares multiple times between August and October 2026.
EPF issued a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder in October 2026.
earnings_en: For the period ended 30 June 2026, the company recorded revenue of MYR 34,844,000 and net income of MYR 9,548,000, with a net margin of 27.4%.
